### Library Helpers

| Symbol | Type | Description | Docs |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`dashboard`](../lib/monitoring.md#dashboard) | `dashboard :: AttrSet  # Values - `ds`: Provisioned metrics and logs datasource descriptor references (`metrics`, `prometheus`, `logs`). - `promTarget`, `logsTarget`: Construct metrics (`PromQL`/`MetricsQL`) or logs (`LogsQL`) target objects (`expr`, `legend`, `queryType`). - `thresholds`, `mappings`: Standard threshold presets and Grafana value mappings. - `links`: Click-to-drilldown Grafana data links (`toTaskManager`, `toTimeMachine`, `toHostHardware`, `toService`, `toUnitLogs`, `toCapacityAnalytics`, `toTrendsExplorer`, `toMetricWorkbench`). - `vars`: Template variable constructors (`host`, `promQuery`, `logsField`, `custom`, `textbox`). - `statToggleExpr`, `statBandOverrides`, `systemdOpsParsePipe`: Statistical envelope toggles, overlay styling, and systemd accounting LogsQL parser. - `mkStat`, `mkRatioStat`, `mkBarGauge`, `mkTimeseries`, `mkTable`, `mkStorageTable`, `mkSystemdUnitsTable`, `mkLogs`, `mkText`: Pre-styled Grafana v39 panel builders. - `mkRow`, `mkSection`, `mkDashboard`: Responsive 24-column grid layout engine with automatic host event annotations (`Reboots`, `NixOS Deployments`, `OOM Kills`, `Unit Failures`) and top navigation bar. - `mkFleetOverviewDashboard`, `mkTaskManagerDashboard`, `mkTimeMachineDashboard`, `mkTrendsExplorerDashboard`, `mkMetricWorkbenchDashboard`, `mkLogsExplorerDashboard`, `mkHostHardwareDashboard`, `mkCapacityAnalyticsDashboard`, `mkServicesCatalogDashboard`, `mkServiceInspectorDashboard`, `mkContainersDashboard`: Core infrastructure, statistical capacity, trend exploration, custom metric workbench, and investigation dashboards.` | Opinionated Grafana schema v39 dashboard, layout, panel, variable, annotation, and threshold builders shared across monitoring consumers. | [More →](../lib/monitoring.md#dashboard) |
| [`mkConfig`](../lib/monitoring.md#mkConfig) | `monitoring.mkConfig :: AttrSet -> AttrSet` | Auto-derived configuration binding helper for the 'monitoring' contract. | [More →](../lib/monitoring.md#mkConfig) |
| [`mkOption`](../lib/monitoring.md#mkOption) | `monitoring.mkOption :: AttrSet -> AttrSet` | Auto-derived option constructor for the 'monitoring' contract. | [More →](../lib/monitoring.md#mkOption) |

## Option Schema Definitions

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `monitoring.agent` | `submodule` | `{ }` | Local telemetry collector agent configuration for metrics scraping, log shipping, and remote-write buffering. |
| `monitoring.dashboards` | `attribute set of (submodule)` | `{ }` | Attribute set of declarative Grafana dashboards provisioned automatically as code. |
| `monitoring.enable` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to enable declarative system and service monitoring contract. |
| `monitoring.exporters` | `submodule` | `{ }` | Built-in telemetry exporter configurations (host OS, containers, blackbox probing, and custom blocks). |
| `monitoring.extraAlloyConfig` | `strings concatenated with "\n"` | `""` | Raw Grafana Alloy River configuration blocks appended directly to `/etc/alloy/config.alloy`. |
| `monitoring.extraGrafanaSettings` | `attribute set of anything` | `{ }` | Additional backend-specific attributes merged into `services.grafana.settings`. |
| `monitoring.extraLogsOptions` | `list of string` | `[ ]` | Additional backend-specific CLI flags passed to the central logs storage daemon. |
| `monitoring.extraMetricsOptions` | `list of string` | `[ ]` | Additional backend-specific CLI flags passed to the central metrics storage daemon. |
| `monitoring.logs` | `submodule` | `{ }` | Declarative systemd journal and file-based log ingestion sources. |
| `monitoring.probes` | `attribute set of (submodule)` | `{ }` | Attribute set of blackbox health probes checking HTTP, TCP, or ICMP endpoint reachability. |
| `monitoring.rules` | `attribute set of (submodule)` | `{ }` | Attribute set of alerting and recording rule groups evaluated against metrics or logs. |
| `monitoring.scrapes` | `attribute set of (submodule)` | `{ }` | Attribute set of Prometheus scrape targets collected by the local telemetry agent. |
| `monitoring.server` | `submodule` | `{ }` | Central telemetry ingestion, time-series storage, alerting, and visualization server configuration. |
| `monitoring.services` | `attribute set of (submodule)` | `{ }` | Declarative service catalog mapping logical application names to systemd units, virtual hosts, backup jobs, and storage mounts. |
| `monitoring.watchedUnits` | `list of string` | `[ ]` | Critical systemd units (services, timers, or mounts) registered for health monitoring and journal tracking. |

## Fulfilling Implementations

| Implementation | Description | Definition | Docs |

| [`grafana`](../implementations/grafana.md) | Full observability stack implementation using Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, vmalert, Alertmanager, and Grafana Alloy. | [`modules/implementations/grafana/default.nix`](../../modules/implementations/grafana/default.nix) | [More →](../implementations/grafana.md) |

```nix
config = {
  monitoring.dashboards = {
  auth-security = {
    enable = true;
    folder = "02 · Infrastructure";
    json = {
      annotations = {
        list = [
          {
            builtIn = 1;
            datasource = {
              type = "grafana";
              uid = "-- Grafana --";
            };
            enable = true;
            hide = true;
            iconColor = "rgba(0, 211, 255, 1)";
            name = "Annotations & Alerts";
            type = "dashboard";
          }
          {
            datasource = {
              type = "prometheus";
              uid = "prometheus";
            };
            enable = true;
            expr = "changes(node_boot_time_seconds{host=~\"$host\"}[2m]) > 0";
            hide = false;
            iconColor = "orange";
            name = "Reboots";
            step = "60s";
            tagKeys = "host";
            textFormat = "{{host}} booted";
            titleFormat = "Host Reboot";
            useValueForTime = false;
          }
          {
            datasource = {
              type = "prometheus";
              uid = "prometheus";
            };
            enable = true;
            expr = "changes(nixconf_deployment_timestamp_seconds{host=~\"$host\"}[2m]) > 0";
            hide = false;
            iconColor = "blue";
            name = "NixOS Deployments";
            step = "60s";
            tagKeys = "host,rev";
            textFormat = "{{host}} deployed {{rev}}";
            titleFormat = "NixOS Deploy";
            useValueForTime = false;
          }
          {
            datasource = {
              type = "prometheus";
              uid = "prometheus";
            };
            enable = true;
            expr = "increase(container_oom_events_total{host=~\"$host\"}[2m]) > 0";
            hide = false;
            iconColor = "red";
            name = "OOM Kills";
            step = "60s";
            tagKeys = "host,unit";
            textFormat = "OOM in {{unit}} on {{host}}";
            titleFormat = "OOM Event";
            useValueForTime = false;
          }
          {
            datasource = {
              type = "prometheus";
              uid = "prometheus";
            };
            enable = true;
            expr = "changes(node_systemd_unit_state{host=~\"$host\",state=\"failed\"}[2m]) > 0 and node_systemd_unit_state{host=~\"$host\",state=\"failed\"} == 1";
            hide = false;
            iconColor = "purple";
            name = "Unit Failures";
            step = "60s";
            tagKeys = "host,name";
            textFormat = "{{name}} failed on {{host}}";
            titleFormat = "Unit Failed";
            useValueForTime = false;
          }
        ];
      };
      description = "Authelia SSO authentication attempts, forward-auth authorization decisions, latency percentiles, and SSH/LLDAP security logs.";
      editable = false;
      fiscalYearStartMonth = 0;
      graphTooltip = 1;
      links = [
        {
          asDropdown = true;
          icon = "external link";
          includeVars = true;
          keepTime = true;
          tags = [
            "nixconf"
          ];

              options = {
                code = {
                  language = "plaintext";
                  showLineNumbers = false;
                  showMiniMap = false;
                };
                content = ''
                  ### Unlimited Independent Queries (`+ Query` & Grafana Explore)
                  This dashboard is provisioned with **`editable = true`** (unlike the read-only operational dashboards), so you can go beyond the top-bar dropdowns whenever you want completely independent combinations (e.g. *Suwayomi RAM P95* alongside *LLDAP CPU Avg* alongside *Host Load*):
                  
                  1. **Stack unlimited queries right here:** Click the main panel title → **Edit** → **`+ Query`** (as many times as you like), switch between Grafana's visual **Builder** and **Code** editors, duplicate/disable queries, or assign custom Y-axes. Reloading the page cleanly resets unsaved experiments back to this starter template.
                  2. **Open a blank multi-query canvas:** Click **Open in Explore** in the top navigation bar (or **Panel → Explore** to carry the current graph's queries directly into Explore).
                  
                  ### Precomputed & High-Value MetricsQL Building Blocks
                  | Family | Metric / Expression | Labels |
                  | --- | --- | --- |
                  | **Slice Allocations** | `nixconf:slice_memory_high_bytes`, `nixconf:slice_memory_max_bytes`, `nixconf_resource_slice_cpu_quota_cores` | `host`, `slice` |
                  | **Unit Allocations** | `nixconf:unit_memory_high_bytes`, `nixconf:unit_memory_max_bytes`, `nixconf_resource_unit_cpu_quota_cores` | `host`, `slice`, `unit` |
                  | **Precomputed 5m Rates** | `nixconf:host_cpu_utilization_percent:rate5m`, `nixconf:slice_cpu_cores:rate5m`, `nixconf:unit_cpu_cores:rate5m` | `host`, `slice`, `unit` |
                  | **Unit & Container RAM/CPU** | `container_memory_working_set_bytes`, `rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[$__rate_interval])` | `host`, `slice`, `unit`, `service` |
                  | **Process Stats** | `namedprocess_namegroup_memory_bytes{memtype="resident"}`, `rate(namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total[$__rate_interval])`, `rate(namedprocess_namegroup_read_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])` | `host`, `groupname` |
                  | **Systemd Operations (5m)** | `nixconf_operation_cpu_seconds_5m`, `nixconf_operation_memory_peak_bytes_5m`, `nixconf_operation_io_read_bytes_5m`, `nixconf_operation_io_write_bytes_5m` | `host`, `op_unit` |
                  | **Rolling Stat Wrappers** | `avg_over_time((EXPR)[$rolling:])`, `quantile_over_time(0.95, (EXPR)[$rolling:])`, `stddev_over_time((EXPR)[$rolling:])`, `deriv((EXPR)[$rolling:]) * 86400`, `(EXPR) offset $compare` | — |
                '';
                mode = "markdown";
              };
              title = "Building Unlimited Independent Queries";
              type = "text";
            }
          ];
          title = "Query Builder Cheat Sheet (Unlimited '+ Query' & Explore Reference)";
          type = "row";
        }

  monitoring.rules = {
  authelia = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "AutheliaDown";
        annotations = {
          description = "Authelia metrics scrape target on {{ $labels.host }} has been down for 2 minutes.";
          summary = "Authelia SSO metrics endpoint unreachable";
        };
        expr = "up{job=\"authelia\"} == 0";
        for = "2m";
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  authelia-logs = {
    backend = "logs";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "AutheliaRepeatedAuthFailures";
        annotations = {
          description = "More than 10 failed login or ban events occurred in Authelia over 5 minutes.";
          summary = "Repeated authentication failures in Authelia on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "_time:5m unit:=\"authelia-main.service\" _msg:~\"(?i)(unsuccessful authentication|banned)\" | stats by (host) count() as failures | filter failures:>10";
        for = "1m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  caddy = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "EndpointProbeFailed";
        annotations = {
          description = "Blackbox probe {{ $labels.vhost }} from {{ $labels.host }} has been failing for 3 minutes.";
          summary = "Health probe failed for {{ $labels.vhost }} ({{ $labels.host }})";
        };
        expr = "probe_success == 0";
        for = "3m";
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "CaddyHttp5xxSpike";
        annotations = {
          description = "Caddy is returning more than 0.1 5xx responses/sec for {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "Elevated 5xx responses on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "sum by (host) (rate(caddy_http_request_duration_seconds_count{code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) > 0.1";
        for = "5m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  disk = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "FilesystemSpaceLow";
        annotations = {
          description = "Less than 15% free space remains on {{ $labels.mountpoint }} ({{ $labels.host }}).";
          summary = "Filesystem {{ $labels.mountpoint }} low on space ({{ $labels.host }})";
        };
        expr = "(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~\"tmpfs|ramfs|squashfs|overlay|fuse\\\\..*\",mountpoint!~\"/(etc|nix|var|tmp|run|sys|proc|dev).*\"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~\"tmpfs|ramfs|squashfs|overlay|fuse\\\\..*\",mountpoint!~\"/(etc|nix|var|tmp|run|sys|proc|dev).*\"}) < 0.15";
        for = "10m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "RootTmpfsSpaceLow";
        annotations = {
          description = "Less than 15% free space remains on root tmpfs / ({{ $labels.host }}).";
          summary = "Ephemeral root tmpfs low on space ({{ $labels.host }})";
        };
        expr = "(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=\"/\",fstype=\"tmpfs\"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint=\"/\",fstype=\"tmpfs\"}) < 0.15";
        for = "5m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  host = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "SystemdUnitFailed";
        annotations = {
          description = "Unit {{ $labels.name }} on {{ $labels.host }} has been in failed state for more than 2 minutes.";
          summary = "Systemd unit {{ $labels.name }} failed on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "node_systemd_unit_state{state=\"failed\"} == 1";
        for = "2m";
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "HostHighMemoryUsage";
        annotations = {
          description = "Memory utilization on {{ $labels.host }} is above 90%.";
          summary = "High memory usage on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / clamp_min(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, 1)) * 100 > 90";
        for = "5m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "HostHighCpuLoad";
        annotations = {
          description = "5-minute load per CPU core exceeded 2.0 on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "High 5m load average on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "node_load5 / count without (cpu, mode) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=\"idle\"}) > 2";
        for = "10m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  operations-recording = {
    backend = "logs";
    enable = true;
    interval = "5m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };

        expr = "_time:5m job:=\"systemd-journal\" \"Consumed\" \"CPU time\" | extract_regexp \"^(?P<op_unit>[^:]+): Consumed (?:(?P<cd>[0-9]+)d )?(?:(?P<ch>[0-9]+)h )?(?:(?P<cm>[0-9]+)min )?(?:(?P<cs>[0-9.]+)s|(?P<cms>[0-9.]+)ms) CPU time(?: over (?:(?P<wd>[0-9]+)d )?(?:(?P<wh>[0-9]+)h )?(?:(?P<wm>[0-9]+)min )?(?:(?P<ws>[0-9.]+)s|(?P<wms>[0-9.]+)ms) wall clock time)?(?:, (?P<mn>[0-9.]+)(?P<mu>[BKMGTP]) memory peak)?(?:.*?(?P<rn>[0-9.]+)(?P<ru>[BKMGTP]) read from disk)?(?:.*?(?P<wn>[0-9.]+)(?P<wu>[BKMGTP]) written to disk)?\" | filter op_unit:!~\".*\\\\.slice$\" | replace_regexp (\"^session-[0-9]+\\\\.scope$\", \"session.scope\") at op_unit | replace_regexp (\"^(app-[^@]+)@[0-9a-f]+\\\\.service$\", \"\${1}.service\") at op_unit | replace_regexp (\"^(app-.+)-[0-9]+\\\\.scope$\", \"\${1}.scope\") at op_unit | math (cd default 0)*86400 + (ch default 0)*3600 + (cm default 0)*60 + (cs default 0) + (cms default 0)/1000 as cpu_s, (wd default 0)*86400 + (wh default 0)*3600 + (wm default 0)*60 + (ws default 0) + (wms default 0)/1000 as wall_s | replace (\"B\",\"1\") at mu | replace (\"K\",\"1024\") at mu | replace (\"M\",\"1048576\") at mu | replace (\"G\",\"1073741824\") at mu | replace (\"T\",\"1099511627776\") at mu | replace (\"B\",\"1\") at ru | replace (\"K\",\"1024\") at ru | replace (\"M\",\"1048576\") at ru | replace (\"G\",\"1073741824\") at ru | replace (\"T\",\"1099511627776\") at ru | replace (\"B\",\"1\") at wu | replace (\"K\",\"1024\") at wu | replace (\"M\",\"1048576\") at wu | replace (\"G\",\"1073741824\") at wu | replace (\"T\",\"1099511627776\") at wu | math (mn default 0)*(mu default 1) as mem_peak_bytes, (rn default 0)*(ru default 1) as io_read_bytes, (wn default 0)*(wu default 1) as io_write_bytes | stats by (host, op_unit) sum(io_write_bytes)";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf_operation_io_write_bytes_5m";
      }
    ];
  };
  persistence = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "PersistVolumeSpaceCritical";
        annotations = {
          description = "Less than 10% free space remains on /persist on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "Low free space on /persist on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=\"/persist\"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint=\"/persist\"}) < 0.10";
        for = "5m";
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  resources = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "CgroupMemoryNearLimit";
        annotations = {
          description = "Unit {{ $labels.unit }} in {{ $labels.slice }} slice has used more than 85% of its memory limit for 5 minutes.";
          summary = "Cgroup {{ $labels.unit }} near memory limit on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "(container_memory_working_set_bytes{unit!=\"\"} / (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{unit!=\"\"} > 0)) * 100 > 85";
        for = "5m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "CgroupCpuThrottled";
        annotations = {
          description = "Unit {{ $labels.unit }} experienced CPU CFS quota throttling on over 25% of periods for 10 minutes.";
          summary = "Cgroup {{ $labels.unit }} CPU-throttled on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "(rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{unit!=\"\"}[5m]) / clamp_min(rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{unit!=\"\"}[5m]), 1)) * 100 > 25";
        for = "10m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "HostMemoryPressureHigh";
        annotations = {
          description = "Memory PSI stall rate on {{ $labels.host }} exceeded 10% over 5 minutes.";
          summary = "Elevated Linux PSI memory pressure on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total[5m]) * 100 > 10";
        for = "5m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "CgroupOomKilled";
        annotations = {
          description = "Kernel or cgroup OOM kill recorded for {{ $labels.unit }} on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "Cgroup OOM event in {{ $labels.unit }} on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "increase(container_oom_events_total{unit!=\"\"}[5m]) > 0";
        for = null;
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "LocalVolumeSpaceWarning";
        annotations = {
          description = "Declarative volume {{ $labels.volume }} ({{ $labels.mountpoint }}, {{ $labels.mode }}) has less than 20% free space remaining on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "Local volume {{ $labels.volume }} low on free space on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "(((node_filesystem_avail_bytes / clamp_min(node_filesystem_size_bytes, 1)) * 100) * on (host, mountpoint) group_left (volume, mode) (nixconf_disk_volume_size_bytes{mountpoint!=\"reserved-unmounted\"} * 0 + 1)) < 20";
        for = "10m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "LocalVolumeSpaceCritical";
        annotations = {
          description = "Declarative volume {{ $labels.volume }} ({{ $labels.mountpoint }}, {{ $labels.mode }}) has less than 10% free space remaining on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "Local volume {{ $labels.volume }} critically full on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "(((node_filesystem_avail_bytes / clamp_min(node_filesystem_size_bytes, 1)) * 100) * on (host, mountpoint) group_left (volume, mode) (nixconf_disk_volume_size_bytes{mountpoint!=\"reserved-unmounted\"} * 0 + 1)) < 10";
        for = "5m";
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "LocalVolumeInodesLow";
        annotations = {
          description = "Declarative volume {{ $labels.volume }} ({{ $labels.mountpoint }}) has less than 15% free inodes remaining on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "Local volume {{ $labels.volume }} low on free inodes on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "(((node_filesystem_files_free / clamp_min(node_filesystem_files, 1)) * 100) * on (host, mountpoint) group_left (volume, mode) (nixconf_disk_volume_size_bytes{mountpoint!=\"reserved-unmounted\"} * 0 + 1)) < 15";
        for = "10m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "RemoteStorageBudgetWarning";
        annotations = {
          description = "Storage slice {{ $labels.slice }} exceeded its warning percentage threshold.";
          summary = "Remote storage slice {{ $labels.slice }} approaching budget on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "(nixconf_storage_budget_used_bytes / clamp_min(nixconf_storage_budget_limit_bytes, 1)) * 100 > nixconf_storage_budget_warn_percent";
        for = "15m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "RemoteStorageBudgetExceeded";
        annotations = {
          description = "Storage slice {{ $labels.slice }} usage is at or above its configured maxSize budget.";
          summary = "Remote storage slice {{ $labels.slice }} exceeded budget on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "nixconf_storage_budget_used_bytes >= nixconf_storage_budget_limit_bytes";
        for = "5m";
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  resources-logs = {
    backend = "logs";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "OomKillDetected";
        annotations = {
          description = "Kernel OOM killer or systemd-oomd terminated a process on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "OOM kill detected in journal on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "_time:5m job:=\"systemd-journal\" _msg:~\"(?i)(Out of memory: Killed process|systemd-oomd.*Killed)\" | stats by (host) count() as kills | filter kills:>0";
        for = null;
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  resources-recording = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "5m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "max by (host, slice) (nixconf_resource_slice_memory_high_bytes or (nixconf_resource_slice_memory_high_ratio * on (host) group_left () node_memory_MemTotal_bytes))";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:slice_memory_high_bytes";
      }
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "max by (host, slice) (nixconf_resource_slice_memory_max_bytes or (nixconf_resource_slice_memory_max_ratio * on (host) group_left () node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) or (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{id=~\"/[^/]+\\\\.slice\",slice!=\"\"} > 0))";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:slice_memory_max_bytes";
      }
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "max by (host, slice, unit) (nixconf_resource_unit_memory_high_bytes or (nixconf_resource_unit_memory_high_ratio * on (host) group_left () node_memory_MemTotal_bytes))";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:unit_memory_high_bytes";
      }
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "max by (host, slice, unit) (nixconf_resource_unit_memory_max_bytes or (nixconf_resource_unit_memory_max_ratio * on (host) group_left () node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) or (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{unit!=\"\"} > 0))";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:unit_memory_max_bytes";
      }
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "100 - (avg by (host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=\"idle\"}[5m])) * 100)";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:host_cpu_utilization_percent:rate5m";
      }
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "max by (host) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes)";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:host_memory_used_bytes";
      }
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "sum by (host, slice) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{id=~\"/[^/]+\\\\.slice\",slice!=\"\"}[5m]))";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:slice_cpu_cores:rate5m";
      }
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "max by (host, slice, unit) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{unit!=\"\"}[5m]))";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:unit_cpu_cores:rate5m";
      }
      {
        alert = null;
        annotations = { };
        expr = "sum by (host, groupname) (rate(namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total[5m]))";
        for = "5m";
        labels = { };
        record = "nixconf:process_cpu_cores:rate5m";
      }
    ];
  };
  restic = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "ResticBackupUnitFailed";
        annotations = {
          description = "Restic backup or restore unit {{ $labels.name }} entered failed state on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "Restic unit {{ $labels.name }} failed on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "node_systemd_unit_state{name=~\"restic-(backups|restore)-.*\\\\.service\",state=\"failed\"} == 1";
        for = "1m";
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "ResticBackupStale";
        annotations = {
          description = "Restic backup timer {{ $labels.name }} has not triggered in over 48 hours on {{ $labels.host }}. It may be permanently deferred due to missing AC power.";
          summary = "Restic backup timer {{ $labels.name }} is stale on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "time() - (node_systemd_timer_last_trigger_seconds{name=~\"restic-backups-.*\\\\.timer\"} or vector(time())) > 2 * 24 * 3600";
        for = "1h";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  snapshot = {
    backend = "metrics";
    enable = true;
    interval = "1m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "HostSnapshotUnitFailed";
        annotations = {
          description = "Btrfs/restic host snapshot unit {{ $labels.name }} failed on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "Host snapshot unit {{ $labels.name }} failed on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "node_systemd_unit_state{name=~\"host-snapshot-.*\\\\.service\",state=\"failed\"} == 1";
        for = "1m";
        labels = {
          severity = "critical";
        };
        record = null;
      }
      {
        alert = "HostSnapshotStale";
        annotations = {
          description = "Host snapshot timer {{ $labels.name }} has not triggered in over 48 hours on {{ $labels.host }}. It may be permanently deferred due to missing AC power.";
          summary = "Host snapshot timer {{ $labels.name }} is stale on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "time() - (node_systemd_timer_last_trigger_seconds{name=~\"host-snapshot-.*\\\\.timer\"} or vector(time())) > 2 * 24 * 3600";
        for = "1h";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
  ssh = {
    backend = "logs";
    enable = true;
    interval = "5m";
    rules = [
      {
        alert = "SshInvalidAuthSpike";
        annotations = {
          description = "More than 15 failed SSH authentication attempts in 5 minutes on {{ $labels.host }}.";
          summary = "SSH failed authentication spike on {{ $labels.host }}";
        };
        expr = "_time:5m unit:=\"sshd.service\" _msg:~\"(?i)(invalid user|failed password|connection closed by authenticating user)\" | stats by (host) count() as failures | filter failures:>15";
        for = "1m";
        labels = {
          severity = "warning";
        };
        record = null;
      }
    ];
  };
};
};
```
